thread:
carmen: Quick find from the quarterly entitlement sweep: telemetry-prod has a mixed-scope IAM binding that grants roles/kms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter to a group with external members and several ownerless svcaccts. Some svcaccts also referenced in an old terraform state. We need a safe cleanup plan.

pete: can you share the export and which keys are affected? we should avoid any blind revokes.

carmen: uploaded CSV -> https://drive.internal/redwood/access-reviews/4301239876_telemetry_bindings.csv. key columns: principal, last_used_ts, roles, kms_key_id, iam_path, terraform_ref.

sasha: quick grep showed 2 svcaccts with kms grants to keyring telemetry-keys/prod and one terraform state referencing key id `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/telemetry/cryptoKeys/old-key-1234`. that's the risky one.

ryan: plan suggestion: 1) create SecTracker tickets for each ownerless principal 2) require claim window 72h 3) mark KMS-bound principals as `requires-kms-handshake` 4) provision temp key and perform a canary rotation for callers before revoke.

security-bot: [policy] Ownerless principals with persistent KMS grants require SecEng lead approval + Compliance sign-off for emergency revoke. External principals must be validated. Flagged: 6 principals, 3 with KMS grants.

carmen: I'll import the CSV into SecTracker and attach the following evidence template: last_used_logs, iam_diff_commit, terraform_state_link, risk_level (low/med/high), kms_handshake_required (yes/no). sec-tracker-bot, please create tickets and return links.

sec-tracker-bot: Created tickets: SEC-5421, SEC-5422, SEC-5423. Each ticket includes the evidence template and `claim_by` field set to EOD+3.

pete: for the terraform-referenced key: we must rotate it immediately because it appears in state. propose temporary key: `telemetry-temp-4301239876`, switch a small canary of callers (5%), run smoke tests, monitor decrypt errors for 30m, then rotate remaining callers and revoke grants.

sasha: agree. please add a log sink to capture PermissionDenied errors and a short retention 14d so audit can replay. Add the error filter `protoPayload.status.code=7 OR jsonPayload.message:"Permission denied"`.

ryan: maintenance window proposal: 01:30-02:30 UTC tomorrow. If the canary shows >4 failed decrypts in 10m, rollback to old key and escalate. oncall-bot, create a temporary monitor for the window.

oncall-bot: Monitor created: "kms-canary-4301239876" -> pages eng-oncall on breach (threshold: 4 failed decrypts / 10m). Paging severity: sev2.

pete: rotation steps (short):
```
1. provision key telemetry-temp-4301239876 in same keyring
2. update CANARY callers env var to temp key
3. run smoke-tests in prod-canary (5% traffic)
4. if OK -> update remaining callers and rotate
5. revoke old grants and unlink svcaccts
```

carmen: add compliance note: snapshot IAM bindings and IAM audit logs immediately before any revoke. attach snapshots to each SEC ticket. Compliance will need commit that added original binding, last_used evidence, and claim judgement.

sasha: also found one external group in the binding that includes `vendor-oncall@external.com`. policy says external groups must be explicitly approved. mark that principal in SEC-5421 as `requires-sec-eng-approval`.

security-bot: Reminder: use `emergency-revoke` only after two approvers and SecEng lead sign-off. Also capture justification text in ticket when proceeding.

ryan: timeline: import+tickets (today), claim window 72h, if unclaimed schedule KMS-handshake in maintenance window (tomorrow 01:30-02:30 UTC). If any unexpected failures or >10% canary failures, pause and open incident. We'll document rollback steps in the ticket.

carmen: I'll attach the rotation runbook and a short rollback script in the tickets. also adding label `break-risk` if any ticket shows terraform references or external principals.

pete: I'll prep the dry-run script (no-op) and post the output here prior to the window. sample gcloud to list bindings:
```
gcloud iam roles list --project=telemetry-prod && gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy old-key-1234 --keyring=telemetry --location=global
```

sasha: once dry-run output looks good, sec-tracker-bot please move tickets to `scheduled` and include maintenance window.

sec-tracker-bot: Tickets SEC-5421/5422/5423 moved to scheduled for 4301247300 (01:30 UTC).

oncall-bot: FYI I've also created a short alert window: will only page during monitor active window.

carmen: thanks all. last ask: capture PR history touching iam_path and add that as evidence. I'll follow up with ticket numbers for auditors after rotation. :white_check_mark:
